The **Time Series** group of the node palette has 14 nodes: all run.

| Node | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [ACF](../time-series/acf.md) | Runs | Autocorrelation by lag with its Bartlett band and the Ljung-Box white-noise test. |
| [ARIMA](../time-series/arima.md) | Runs | ARIMA(p, d, q) by exact maximum likelihood: fitted and residual columns, and future rows with forecast / low / high. |
| [Decomposition](../time-series/decomposition.md) | Runs | Split a series into trend, seasonal and residual columns (STL, or classical with empty edges) |
| [Differencing](../time-series/differencing.md) | Runs | Difference a numeric column by lag and order. |
| [Exp. Smoothing](../time-series/exp-smoothing.md) | Runs | Simple, Holt or Holt-Winters smoothing: fitted and residual columns, and future rows with forecast / low / high. |
| [PACF](../time-series/pacf.md) | Runs | Partial autocorrelation by lag (Durbin-Levinson) with its band. |
| [Seasonal Naive](../time-series/seasonal-naive.md) | Runs | Repeat the latest seasonal cycle as a deterministic forecast baseline. |
| [Seasonality Detector](../time-series/seasonality-detector.md) | Runs | Candidate seasonal periods of the detrended periodogram, ranked by their share of the power. |
| [Sliding Window](../time-series/sliding-window.md) | Runs | Create sliding windows. |
| [Stationarity Test](../time-series/stationarity-test.md) | Runs | ADF and KPSS on the series and its first and second differences, with the suggested differencing. |
| [Time Integrity & Segments](../time-series/time-integrity-segments.md) | Runs | Validate ordered timestamps and assign continuous segment IDs. |
| [TS Features](../time-series/ts-features.md) | Runs | Extract TS features. |
| [TS Lag](../time-series/ts-lag.md) | Runs | Add lag columns for one numeric time-series column. |
| [TS Split](../time-series/ts-split.md) | Runs | Chronological split. |
